title: Paysign is a Sponsor at the Plasma Protein Therapeutic Association Forum, Alexandria, VA
summary: Paysign will be a sponsor at the Plasma Protein Therapeutic Association Forum in Alexandria, VA, on November 3-4, 2026. This annual conference brings together policymakers, industry leaders, healthcare professionals and patients together to learn more about key developments and current issues within the plasma industry.
body_markdown: Paysign will be a sponsor at the **[Plasma Protein Therapeutic Association Forum](https://www.pptaglobal.org/events/plasma-protein-forum)** in Alexandria, VA, on November 3-4, 2026. This annual conference brings together policymakers, industry leaders, healthcare professionals and patients together to learn more about key developments and current issues within the plasma industry.
